results.evidence: Before/after snapshot equality confirmed. Core checks pass: source hashes, deterministic 451-section inventory, 7 extractor tests, 37 runner/replay tests, 53 archived file hashes, library build and 353-declaration audit. Only standard Lean axioms occur. Final worker replay passes all 16 new proofs and independent assertions. Both compile-passing seeded defects are rejected at exactly the intended false assertions; the positive control passes. Independent reviewers checked publication and qualifier origin, noncircular witnesses, source fidelity and min/max assumptions. The upstream package builds; all six exact graph endpoints, including polynomial correspondence and backward success/VJP, have only standard axioms. Artifact hashes match the verification receipt. An isolated, unchanged core build under Lean 4.34 also passes all 353 audits; joint-package integration is not yet claimed. Failed attempts and evaluator failures remain preserved.
